beach.name: 塔赞渔滩
beach.desc: 塔赞之城外的一小片沙滩，几名渔人在此浅滩垂钓。这里只有一根鱼竿、一只水桶，以及今日上钩的收获。
beach.descEn: A short strip of sand just outside the City of Tazan, where a few anglers work the shallows. Nothing here but a rod, a bucket, and whatever is biting today.

fish.name: 白骨鱼骸
fish.desc: 曾在此游弋之物只余白骨，其余的都进了海鸥的肚子。商人愿意为它付出可观的金币。
fish.descEn: Whatever swam here left only bone. The gulls got the rest. A merchant will pay good gold for it.

fish.name: 条纹文蛤
fish.desc: 紧闭如铁，比看上去更沉。厨子们最爱用它熬汤。商人愿意为它付出可观的金币。
fish.descEn: Sealed tight and heavier than it looks. Cooks swear by the broth. A merchant will pay good gold for it.

fish.name: 锈钳螯虾
fish.desc: 双钳能夹碎指节。徒手去抓也值得冒这个险。商人愿意为它付出丰厚的金币。
fish.descEn: Its pincers can crack a knuckle. Worth the risk of catching one by hand. A merchant will pay handsomely for it.

fish.name: 月鳞鲦
fish.desc: 苍白如沉底的银币。渔妇说它只在无云之夜浮上来。商人愿意为它付出丰厚的金币。
fish.descEn: Pale as a drowned coin. Fishwives say it only rises on cloudless nights. A merchant will pay handsomely for it.

fish.name: 辉鳍神仙鱼
fish.desc: 日落之后，鳞片仍久久含光。收藏家愿以重金求一条完好的。商人愿意为它掏出一小笔财富。
fish.descEn: Its scales hold light long after the sun is gone. Collectors pay in gold for a whole one. A merchant will pay a small fortune for it.

fish.name: 珊瑚绯鱼
fish.desc: 礁石般的绯红，触手温热。一离开浅水便会死去。商人愿意为它掏出一小笔财富。
fish.descEn: Reef-red and warm to the touch. It dies the moment it leaves the shallows. A merchant will pay a small fortune for it.

fish.name: 青斑鱼
fish.desc: 每秒回复10点生命，持续1小时。
fish.descEn: Restore 10 Life per second for 1 hour.
